standard.summary: 用于检测 loss spike 的滑动窗口大小（步数），窗口内均值作为「正常 loss」基准。默认 20。
standard.effect: 窗口越大，基准均值越稳定，不易被短暂波动影响；窗口越小，基准对近期 loss 更敏感。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 20 适合大多数训练。总步数 <100 时可减小到 5~10；长训练（>1000 步）可增大到 50。
standard.avoidWhen: 窗口过小（<5）时均值不稳定；过大（>100）时基准更新太慢，早期 spike 可能被淹没。

standard_en.summary: The size of the sliding window (in steps) used to detect a loss spike; the mean inside the window is the baseline for a normal loss. Default 20.
standard_en.effect: The larger the window, the steadier the baseline mean and the less a brief fluctuation moves it; the smaller it is, the more sensitive the baseline is to the recent loss.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default 20 suits most runs. With under 100 total steps you can reduce it to 5~10; on a long run (>1000 steps) you can raise it to 50.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too small a window (<5) makes the mean unsteady; too large (>100) updates the baseline too slowly and an early spike may be drowned out.

advanced.principle: 使用循环队列（deque with maxlen=window_size）维护最近 N 步 loss，取均值为 spike 检测基准。
advanced.tradeoffs: 窗口大小影响「正常 loss」基准的平滑程度，与 spike_threshold 共同决定触发灵敏度。

advanced_en.principle: Uses a circular queue (deque with maxlen=window_size) to maintain the last N steps' loss and takes the mean as the spike detection baseline.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Window size affects how smoothed the "normal loss" baseline is, and together with spike_threshold determines trigger sensitivity.
